slides.title: Used to
slides.subtitle: Used to: hábitos y estados del pasado
goals: Hablar de cosas que **ya no** pasan.
Formar negativas y preguntas con **didn't use to / Did you use to…?**
Comparar el pasado con el presente.

slides.title: Forma
list: Hábitos pasados: *We used to go to the beach every summer.*
Estados pasados: *She used to have long hair.*
slides.watch: Solo para el **pasado**. Para el presente se usa *usually*: *I usually walk* (no *I use to walk*).

items.en: I used to be shy, but now I'm outgoing.
items.es: Antes era tímido, pero ahora soy sociable.

items.en: There used to be a cinema here.
Did you use to watch cartoons? — Yes, every day!

items.t: My dad ___ smoke, but he stopped. (used to)
I ___ like coffee, but now I love it. (negativa)

items.q: ¿Cómo se dice *De niño jugaba en la calle*?
options: When I was a child, I used to play in the street.
When I was a child, I use to play in the street.

items.q: ¿Cómo se dice *Normalmente me levanto a las 7*?
options: I use to get up at 7.
